policies.sentence: Students should start every AI session with the course-provided tutor prompt.
Students may use the course's own or approved AI tool for explanations, homework and studying.
Students must complete homework alongside the course's AI tutor.
The course offers its own AI chatbot as a resource.
The course AI tutor guides students without solving, limiting hints per exercise.
Students must log in to the approved AI tool with university credentials.
Students must not use any AI tool other than the approved one.
